The English word is analysable as Sybarite (“inhabitant of Sybaris”) + -ic. Sybaris, a city of Magna Graecia (the coastal parts of Sicily and southern Italy once colonized by Greek settlers), was known for its wealth and the excesses and hedonism of its inhabitants.

The anomalous condition, in humans, of having some fingers or toes fused with a web.

blocks.etymology: Borrowed from Georgian თამადა (tamada), from (Proto-?)Circassian *tħamada (compare West Circassian тхьаматэ (tḥamatɛ, “foreman of a village; boss; master; chairman; (dated) husband”), East Circassian тхьэмадэ (tḥɛmadɛ, “foreman of a village; boss; master; chairman; (dialectal) bridegroom, wooer”)), possibly from Persian داماد (dâmâd, “bridegroom; son-in-law; father-in-law; sovereign's brother-in-law; lover, wooer”) with the ending reshaped under the influence of East Circassian адэ (adɛ, “father”). The suggestion that the word is derived from a blend of თავი (tavi, “head”) + მაგიდა (magida, “table”) (in the sense of a person at the head of a table) is a folk etymology.

wiktionary.gloss: A toastmaster at a feast in the Caucasus, especially in Georgia.
Of a woman: voluptuously curvy, with large hips.

blocks.etymology: Back-formation from transaction, or else from Latin trānsāctus, past participle of trānsigere.

senses.definition: To carry out or manage business, financial deals, or official affairs.

examples.en: Customers can safely transact business through the bank's mobile application.
examples.vi: Khách hàng có thể thực hiện giao dịch an toàn qua ứng dụng di động của ngân hàng.

examples.en: They prefer to transact in cash rather than using cards.
examples.vi: Họ thích giao dịch bằng tiền mặt hơn là dùng thẻ.

senses.vi: giao dịch; kinh doanh; thực hiện giao dịch

thesaurus.definition: conduct business

vi_block: Kinh doanh với; thương lượng công việc với.

wiktionary.gloss: To do, carry through, conduct or perform.
To carry over, hand over or transfer something.
To conduct business.
To exchange or trade, as of ideas, money, goods, etc.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English troye, from Anglo-Norman. According to the American Heritage Dictionary, probably first used at a fair in Troyes, France.

senses.definition: Belonging to a system of weights used for precious metals like gold and silver.

examples.en: The price of one troy ounce of gold increased today.
examples.vi: Giá của một ounce tơrôi vàng đã tăng vào hôm nay.

wiktionary.gloss: Of, or relating to, troy weight.

vi_block: Không bị đòi hỏi; không bị yêu sách.

examples: Any unclaimed items of luggage may be destroyed.
wiktionary.gloss: Not claimed.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English ondauntit, undauntdid; equivalent to un- + daunted.

senses.definition: still confident and determined to continue, even after facing danger, failure, or difficulties

examples.en: Undaunted by the bad weather, they continued their climb up the mountain.
examples.vi: Không nản lòng trước thời tiết xấu, họ tiếp tục leo lên đỉnh núi.

senses.vi: không bị khuất phục; ngoan cường; không nản lòng

wiktionary.gloss: Showing courage and resolution.
Not shaken, discouraged or disheartened.
